parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle or knob of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water by rotating or lifting to open or close the valve mechanism inside the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or move up and down depending on the faucet design to regulate water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of brass for strength and resistance to corrosion.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, houses the internal water channels, and connects to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural stability for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel for durability and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel or remain fixed depending on the faucet design, allowing directional control of water flow.
